transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I've just been feeling incredibly depressed and sad all the time, and there's this heavy emptiness inside me that won't go away. It's been like this for about a year and two months now, and I just couldn't carry it anymore.
Have you had periods of feeling this way for most of the day, more days than not, for at least two years, or is this the first time you've felt this consistently down?

Yes, I've been feeling this way consistently for most of the day, every single day, but it hasn't been for two years. It has been ongoing like this for about a year and two months now. This is the first time I've ever felt this down for such a long stretch.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in most or all activities you used to enjoy, nearly every day?
Yes, I've completely lost interest in all the hobbies and activities I used to love. Even when I try to do them, I don't feel any pleasure or happiness at all, just a flat and empty feeling.
During the past two years, have there been any periods lasting at least two months where you felt significantly better—where your mood was stable and these symptoms were clearly reduced?
No, I don't recall having any periods where I felt significantly better since this started a year and two months ago. It has just been a constant, heavy weight the entire time without any breaks.
Looking back further, did you experience any long periods of low mood starting before age 21, even if they seemed mild at the time?
I don't recall having any long periods of low mood before this current episode started. I'm not really sure, but I don't think I ever felt like this when I was younger.
Has your low mood been present for most of the day, more days than not, for at least two years, even if the severity has fluctuated?
No, it hasn't been going on for two years. These feelings of being depressed and low almost every day started about a year and two months ago, and they have been completely persistent since then.
